response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS average_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS sf JOIN sites AS s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT site_code, access_status, average_traitcount, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS record_share FROM grouped ORDER BY record_share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
